newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Two S.Korean firms seek 21,000T of U.S. wheat.
newsitem.headline: Two S.Korean firms seek 21,000T of U.S. wheat.

text.p: South Korea's Cheil Jedang Corp and Dongah Flour Mills Co Ltd have jointly invited tenders to buy 21,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat by 2:00 p.m. (0500GMT) on Wednesday, traders said on Tuesday.
Cheil Jedang wants to buy 11,000 tonnes at basis prices over May futures on the U.S grain futures exchanges including the Chicago Board of Trade, traders said.
Dongah Flour is seeking the remaining 10,000 tonnes at fixed prices.
Shipment was set for April 10-May 10 to the western port of Inchon.
